articles.summary: Flex (NASDAQ: FLEX) today announced that it will host its 2026 Innovation Day on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at the company's headquarters in Austin, Texas. The event will feature presentations from members of the senior leadership teams of Flex and Axiom, the planned independent, publicly-traded company comprising Flex's Cloud and Power Infrastructure segment following the expected spin-off. Presentations will focus on each company's strategy, market opportunities, and financial priorities. Innovation Day will be held in-person for invited institutional investors and financial analysts. The presentation portions for both companies will also be available to the public through separate webcasts, beginning at: Flex: 8:00 AM CT / 9:00 AM ET Axiom: 12:00 PM CT / 1:00 PM ET The live webcasts and accompanying presentation materials will be available on the Flex Investor Relations website at investors.flex.com . articles.title: Flex to Host Innovation Day on November 10, 2026
